How do I activate my Steam Gift Card?

To activate the gift card you have purchased, simply connect to https://store.steampowered.com/account/redeemwalletcode and enter the gift card code you purchased. After entering the gift card code you have purchased, your balance is automatically loaded and you can start using it. Depending on the gift card country you purchased, there may be changes in package prices. Gift card codes are based on their country of origin, and some Google gift cards cannot be used in other countries. You can review the product descriptions for gift card purchase terms.
